name: Language-Driven Image Editing Dataset
description: Language-driven image editing can significantly save the laborious image editing work and be friendly to the photography novice. However, most similar work can only deal with a specific image domain or can only do global retouching. To solve this new task, we first present a new language-driven image editing dataset that supports both local and global editing with editing operation and mask annotations. Besides, we also propose a baseline method that fully utilizes the annotation to solve this problem. Our new method treats each editing operation as a sub-module and can automatically predict operation parameters. Not only performing well on challenging user data, but such an approach is also highly interpretable. We believe our work, including both the benchmark and the baseline, will advance the image editing area towards a more general and free-form level.
evaluation_method: mIoU / accuracy (operation prediction) / perceptual quality metrics (PSNR/SSIM)
general_score_metric: mIoU (for masks) and accuracy (for operation prediction)
reputation: Academic dataset with moderate visibility in the image-editing research community, primarily used in specialized papers.
notes: Relatively small and specialized dataset; covers limited domains and requires paired mask/operation annotations. Not primarily targeted at large LLMs; evaluation mixes geometric (mask) and perceptual metrics.
